artifact_observations.reasoning: The face/visor area of the helmet lacks clear definition. It appears as a dark, somewhat melted or indistinct void rather than a structured visor or open face. This suggests a generation artifact where facial features or visor mechanics failed to resolve clearly.

The articulation between the vambrace (forearm) and the gauntlet/hand is unclear. The hand appears to merge into the forearm armor without distinct fingers or a clear joint mechanism, looking slightly 'melted' or structurally collapsed.
The lines of the wooden wall panels and the floor exhibit slight waviness and inconsistent perspective convergence, typical of AI-generated backgrounds struggling with rigid geometric structures.
The pauldron on the viewer's left seems to blend slightly into the neck/collar area without a crisp boundary, suggesting minor fusion between adjacent armor plates.
